title: A choice-free approach to Wallman compactifications
summary: The classical Wallman compactification of a $T_1$-space and the Stone--Čech compactification of a completely regular space rely on choice principles. We show that, by representing a space by its powerset MT-algebra (McKinsey--Tarski algebra), both constructions admit choice-free compactifications. More generally, from any Wallman basis of a spatial $T_1$ MT-algebra we construct a compact $T_1$ MT-algebra which is a compactification of the original algebra.
